page.notes: Page number printed with a long-tailed 3 ("10³"), read as 103. Several doubtful readings are marked [?]: "ius-fit" (long-s form, probably iussit), "I-tè" (the word at the line start), and "Hitthęi" (the e-cedilla form). The printed "f" in "fuis", "difplicere", "Faftus", "Bafmath" and "Ifahac" is long s and has been read as s. The printed "eft" is read as est, following the rules. The paragraph breaks are a guess: the first line of the page is a fragment and the page ends mid-paragraph. No catchword is visible below the last line.
